summary: Installations recover more gracefully when a step fails.

fixes.title: A resumed install is no longer refused
fixes.text: Resuming a stopped installation now continues where it stopped, instead of being refused by its own update ring check.

fixes.title: A failed side step keeps a healthy app
fixes.text: When a side step such as the updater or alerting fails, setup no longer rolls a healthy PIM Manager back. A rollback happens only when the app itself fails its health check.

fixes.title: Clearer message when an install step fails
fixes.text: Under Invardia's installer, a failed step now tells you what failed, the fix when known, and the one command to resume.
